hooks.name: Byte-budget check

action.prompt: Check that the header length, CRC length and the four capacities in src/protocol/budget.ts and src/protocol/frame.ts still match the size table in .kiro/specs/frame-protocol/design.md. Report any mismatch, and say that a header change needs a size-table update (Requirement 15). Don't edit any file.

hooks.description: Checks the frame header and capacities against the size table whenever frame code changes.
